{"source":"data","name":"top_paid_customer","sql":"SELECT c.customer, COUNT(o.order_id) AS paid_orders
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.order_id) DESC, c.customer ASC) = 1"}
